name: Terrors From the Deep
summary: At Powderfuse Port, you seek a sailor who can identify a sea monster painted on a hide. The strange image may point to a beast in these waters.

sections.title: A Painted Beast
sections.body: A painted hide brings you to Powderfuse Port, where a sailor may recognize the beast. Fish guts and squid ink form a long-necked shape rising from the waves. If it belongs to a real monster in these waters, someone who sails here may know it.

faq.q: What is painted on the hide?
faq.answer: The hide shows a long-necked sea monster rising from the waves, painted with fish guts and squid ink.

faq.q: Where can someone identify the monster?
faq.answer: Powderfuse Port is the nearest port, and a sailor there may recognize the creature.
The painting raises the possibility that a sea monster lurks in these waters, but you are looking for a sailor who can identify it.
